description: AutoSA Design-1 A I/O (paper Fig. 11a §6): L2 unique DRAM fill and L1 replay along j as separate DATAFLOW tasks. Overlay on stream/overlap; do not mix into frozen 20260830_mmflow launchers unless asked.

skills.pattern: load_A pipelines PE index p and/or j inside one II=1 trip so DRAM A is read 16*64 times per k-group (trip ~65536) or fill+replay are sequential in one function (~5513).
skills.strategy: Split AutoSA Design-1 A I/O into two INLINE-off DATAFLOW tasks. A_L2_in reads each A[i][k] once (1024 A_t4 for 64^3 / SIMD4 / 16 PE). A_L1_replay (or PE j==0) reuses that vector for all 64 j. Never put j in the DRAM A trip. Do not clone kernel0 names.
required_steps: A_L2_in: loops ti, tk, kg, p only; PIPELINE II=1; write fifo_l2[p]; trip 1024 if p is in the trip
A_L1_replay: 4096-beat pipeline, p UNROLL, if (j==0) read fifo_l2 else reuse a_reg, write fifo_pe every beat
or fold replay into mm_pe: if (j==0) fifo_A.read()
top DATAFLOW contains A_L2_in and A_L1_replay as separate calls, not one load_A that fills then replays
keep autosa_mm ABI; do not emit void kernel0
guards: fill then replay inside one function is still serial (8*(170+515)=5513)
p inside the DRAM pipeline without UNROLL makes A trip 65536
this is Design 1 (1D along i), not Design 4/5 2D mesh
